laws of magnetic detachment
(the rules unbothered
people live by)

1. let people be wrong
about you

you don't owe everyone
the full story.

2. stop checking who
watched your story

your peace isn't a statistic.

3. reply when you're ready

kindly, calmly.
not instantly.

4. keep a life full of
your own interests

books, walks, projects.
you stop waiting on people.

5. let go of what
wants to leave

no chasing, no explaining.

6. keep learning every day

a curious mind has no time
for drama.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. keep learning every day

i spend 5 minutes a day
on a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
